name: @pageree/mcp-server
description: This server is a core component of the Modular Command Platform (MCP). It acts as a central hub for managing and interacting with various tools and agents.

MCP_PORT.description: The port the server will listen on. Defaults to 3000.

MCP_LOG_LEVEL.description: The log level. Can be info, warn, error, debug. Defaults to info.

MCP_API_KEY.description: An optional API key for securing the server. If not set, the API is open.

npm.description: Run using npx without a global installation. This is the recommended method for quick setup.

docker.description: Run the server using the official Docker image from Docker Hub.
